description: The latest snapshot of one ranking: the place of a security, its ticker, sector, the discount to its own history and to its sector in percent, changes in the line-up and the selection rules. The answer carries no price, price change or multiples: the ranking of securities that got cheaper gives the order, not the size of the fall; per-security multiples come from the screener tool. A ranking is built by rules and is not a recommendation.

lang.description: Language of the names: en, ru or de. Defaults to the server language.

ranking_id.description: Ranking identifier from list_rankings, e.g. undervalued_relative.

name: get_ranking
title: A ranking: places and metrics
